subject: How to get the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix of the estimates after using buildMCEM

messages.author: bc11fbb928eb77ff
messages.subject: How to get the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix of the estimates after using buildMCEM
parts:
Hello again,

we try to use buildMCEM on code on whihc we have already used Nimble. We were wondering how to get the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix of the estimates after using buildMCEM, in addition to the MLE values? Is there any connection with the parameter numReps of buildMCEM?

Thanks a lot for enlighting us.

Sincerely,

Frédéric Gosselin & Eric Parent

messages.author: 0ef2647ddd7095d7
messages.subject: Re: How to get the asymptotic variance-covariance matrix of the estimates after using buildMCEM
parts:
Hi Frédéric and Eric,

Louis (1982) (https://www.jstor.org/stable/2345828?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents) gives the main idea for how to do this from an EM result.  We’ll implement a Monte Carlo version and get back to you.

Perry
